evidence.reason: verify_after_switch itself says rollback permission is one of the three facts a switch must not change. It computes the post-switch compatibility record, but when rollback_compatible is false it only stores rollback_disabled and returns. The negative result is not fail-closed, so callers can proceed with admission/restart without rollback evidence. The smallest compatible fix is to require compatibility before returning, or raise in this branch while the hold is still owned.
